title: CFA Program Level I review
audience: a finance graduate or career changer preparing for the CFA Program exams and a career in investment analysis
prerequisites: C10, C11; helpful: C13, C14, C21.
purpose: Review the full CFA Program Level I body of knowledge with original practice: ethical and professional standards, quantitative methods, economics, financial statement analysis, corporate issuers, equity, fixed income, derivatives, alternative investments and portfolio management, with timed mixed practice and exam strategy.
primary_reading: CFA Institute: CFA Program overview and exam information

weeks.2: Ethics: applying the Standards to cases

blocks.deliverable: Answer forty ethics cases and explain each answer.
Work a timed mixed set on rates, returns and statistics.
Work a timed set on statements and ratios.
Week 7 midterm; a timed half-length mixed exam.
Work a timed set on bonds and derivatives.
Take a full-length timed practice exam.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Exam simulation and error log: take two full-length timed practice exams of original questions, keep an error log that classifies every miss by topic and cause, write a two-week targeted review plan, and retake a fresh mixed set to show improvement.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
